source.title: Lisburn Herald, 20 May 1961, p. 3 ("One contest in Lisburn")
source.publisher: Lisburn Herald (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Ballygomartin count read in the Irish News of 2 June 1961 and the News-Letter of the same date; all other returns from the Lisburn Herald (20 May 1961, p. 3).

note: Triennial election of Lisburn Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. Only the Ballygomartin division (Andersonstown, Suffolk and Hannahstown) was reported as contested in the sources read; the other divisions are not listed in the reports consulted. Returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
